points.text: 1 AVN delays impulse (from sinoatrial node / atrial muscle) ;
2 ring of non-conducting fibrous tissue prevents impulse from sinoatrial node directly passing to ventricles ;
3 impulse must pass through, atrioventricular node / AVN ;
4 (then) passes to Purkyne tissue (to ventricles for contraction) ;

points.guidance: A aortic valve and pulmonary valve
